Trigger You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Confused], controlled, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Fascinated], frightened, or stupefied condition.

You've created a virtual sandbox, a digital clone of your mental programming that contains all your memories and other aspects of your mind except your consciousness. Attempt a @Check[flat|dc:15]. On a success or critical success, you isolate and shunt the condition into your virtual sandbox and don't gain the condition, but you become immune to Virtual Sandbox for 10 minutes.
